summary.text:
Restroom Access Act of 2025
This bill requires businesses to allow a customer to use a nonpublic restroom if the customer has an eligible medical condition (e.g., inflammatory bowel disease) that requires immediate access to a restroom and other conditions are met. The Department of Labor must establish a system of identification cards for customers with eligible medical conditions to present to businesses.
